description: Search Saudi off-plan projects and live developer inventory, compare available units and current prices, and send a preliminary booking request directly from ChatGPT. Off Plan AI rechecks unit availability and price before submission, requires explicit confirmation and consent, returns a Booking ID, and lets users track developer confirmation. Account linking uses OAuth. No payment is collected in ChatGPT, and all requests remain subject to developer confirmation.
